description:
A desktop mod manager for games supported by ModWorkshop.

Modrex is a free, open-source desktop mod manager for PAYDAY 3, PAYDAY 2,
PAYDAY: The Heist, and Crime Boss: Rockay City. Browse, install, organize,
update, enable, and disable mods from ModWorkshop, then launch each game
modded or vanilla directly from the app.
Added
- Added Ready or Not support.
- Added reversible .bk2 movie replacements and Engine.ini presets for supported games.
- Added shortcuts to open game configuration files.
- Added a Health Check scan for known movie mods.
- Added Polish as a language option for the app's interface.
- Added a Health Check warning for mods missing their .ucas and .utoc files.
- Added a Leftover files tab to Health Check for removing unused .ucas and .utoc files.
- Added translation coverage and contributor credits in language settings.
- Added tabs to Installed Mods for games that keep mods in more than one folder.
- Added Instagram to Settings > About.
- Added PAYDAY 3 Mod Loader (PDML) support, including a repair for PDML mods installed as loose paks.
Changed
- Mod descriptions now look the way they do on ModWorkshop and Nexus.
- Scrollbars now float over the content, so pages no longer shift when one appears.
- Health Check stays open while it reinstalls mods or installs dependencies, reinstalls mods one at a time, and shows which ones failed.
- Installed mods show their source under the card instead of over the picture.
- Browse Mods names the mod source in every game.
- PAYDAY: The Heist no longer asks for PDTHModOverrides, which the game now includes.
- Empty pages now have icons.
- Sign in to Nexus Mods right from Browse Mods.
- Installed Mods loads more smoothly.
Fixed
- Fixed the delay when opening a game and the loading flashes when returning to Installed or Browse.
- Fixed list view drag and drop and mod menu.
- Fixed slowdowns when downloading large mods.
- Fixed interacting with popups accidentally dragging mods behind them.
- Fixed game error banners remaining visible after a successful refresh.
- Fixed missing installation progress on mod pages.
- Fixed PAYDAY 3 Xbox builds not being detected as running.
- Fixed Linux builds disabling graphics acceleration.
- Fixed Restart & Install not restarting Modrex on Linux after installing an update.
- Fixed updates offering older versions.
- Fixed UE4SS mods installing to a folder PAYDAY 3's UE4SS does not read.
- Fixed reordering or moving PAYDAY 3 and Crime Boss mods leaving their .ucas and .utoc files behind.
- Fixed deleting a folder also deleting its mods' .ucas and .utoc files.
- Fixed broken formatting, images and videos in mod descriptions.
- Fixed popups closing when resizing the window.
- Fixed updates of multi-file mods skipping renamed files.
- Fixed installing a mod during a launch without mods keeping your other mods from being restored.
- Fixed older UE4SS releases installing as Lua mods.
- Fixed PAYDAY: The Heist showing the wrong DAHM install status.
- Fixed News showing an empty feed instead of an error.
- Fixed Nexus Mods sign-in giving no feedback.
- Fixed mod pages showing the wrong version.
- Fixed wrong update notices for Nexus mods.
Security
- Mod descriptions can no longer use inline styles to draw over the rest of Modrex.
